# Roman Mednitzer

> Personal website of Roman Mednitzer, a senior systems and platform engineer based in Vienna, Austria. It brings together professional infrastructure work, AI-assisted personal projects and wider interests.

Canonical profile: https://rmednitzer.github.io/
Last reviewed: 2026-10-24.

## About

Roman learns through practical work, independent study and experimentation. His professional focus is infrastructure integration and reliable operations; private projects provide room to explore AI, automation and unfamiliar ideas.

## Personal projects and lab

His personal projects are developed with substantial AI assistance. Implementation, testing and documentation are AI-assisted; his contribution covers requirements, integration decisions, review and operational validation. This work is separate from his professional infrastructure experience and does not establish a software-development or ML-research career.

- [relay-shell](https://github.com/rmednitzer/relay-shell): MCP shell and SSH tooling with operation records and optional policy. Open by default, not a sandbox.
- [osint-workbench](https://github.com/rmednitzer/osint-workbench): self-hostable collection, evidence and retrieval workbench. Bounded workflows and a disposable Compose test environment; the full reference platform remains unfinished.

The private lab supports integration, migration and recovery experiments. Routine infrastructure operation uses deterministic automation, independent of external AI providers. Some deliberately complex workflows evaluate agent feedback handling and context retention rather than prescribe a normal production process.

## Professional background

Senior Systems & Platform Engineer with around ten years of production infrastructure experience across managed services, enterprise infrastructure and a regulated medical-device environment. Responsibilities include requirements clarification, hands-on integration, operations, incident response, automation and verified recovery, with SOPs, ISMS documentation, business continuity and ISO/IEC 27001 audit preparation.

He completed an Austrian IT vocational qualification in 2016. German is his native language; he uses English with full professional proficiency. Published employment entries are historical, not a statement of a current employer. Audit support is distinct from auditor certification or legal qualifications.

## Interests and outlook

Interests include AI and robotics, cybernetics, human augmentation, defence and mission systems, edge platforms and high-performance computing. He is interested in technology that extends human capabilities and in understanding and retaining control over the systems people depend on. These are interests and outlook, not claims of specialist or research credentials.

He reads hard science fiction and listens to industrial and electronic body music (EBM). [My Spotify listening profile](https://open.spotify.com/user/31wopsyuay2v65wyqqngc47hv3py) is a listening profile.
